source: ITT Cannon Microminiature Connectors Catalog, Sep 2024
scope: Micro-D family only. MM38999 (Micro 38999 circular) is NOT covered and needs its own catalog.
note: Positional grammar per series. Segments are matched in order against a part number split on dashes, with compact forms (MDM-37SSM5-A174) handled by the decoder.

contact_arrangement.spec_role: size and per-contact increment (spec 5.1). Monotonic price constraint applies (spec 5.2).

values.M2: Jackscrew low profile, allen head (military, size 9-51)
values.M3: Jackscrew standard profile, allen head (military, size 9-51)
values.M5: Jackscrew low profile, slotted head (military, size 9-51)
values.M6: Jackscrew standard profile, slotted head (military, size 9-51)
values.M12: Jackscrew low profile, allen head (military, size 100)
values.M13: Jackscrew standard profile, allen head (military, size 100)
values.M14: Jackscrew low profile, slotted head (military, size 100)
values.M16: Jackscrew standard profile, slotted head (military, size 100)

shell_finish.spec_role: plating adder. Spec 5.2 requires these to move with the gold and silver indices monthly.

values.F300: Ultra-high temperature 230C, micro twist pin contacts

mod_code.spec_role: value adder (spec 5.1). Consult factory for other mod codes.

termination_mod.note: Termination modification code, e.g. 003. Vocabulary is in the catalog's Termination Modification table, not reproduced here.
